notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593287/0fc2b37833f7f21fc82997a7b4a6c0fb8bf6c9d6.png[/img]

[h1] 1.0.5 Update [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Hard difficulty has been added.
    [*]The duration of each difficulty has been changed. (Easy = 10 minutes, Normal = 15 minutes, Hard = 20 minutes)
    [*]Fixed an issue where the volume of certain sounds could not be adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593287/0fc2b37833f7f21fc82997a7b4a6c0fb8bf6c9d6.png[/img]

[h1] 1.0.4 Update [/h1]
[list]
    [*]A button to reset key input settings has been added.
    [*]Added some jump scares.
    [*]The movement speed of Allen while walking has been reduced.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593287/0fc2b37833f7f21fc82997a7b4a6c0fb8bf6c9d6.png[/img]

[h1] 1.0.3 Update [/h1]
[list]
     [*]The lighter gas obtained at the start of the game at the checkpoint is also loaded.
     [*]A difficulty selection function has been added. On Easy difficulty, no lighter gas is required, Allen's walking speed is slightly slower, and hide and seek only lasts 15 minutes.
     [*]Slightly increased the player's running speed.
     [*]Slightly reduced movement speed when Allen is walking.
     [*]Fixed incorrect times in the Hide and Seek guide when playing in some national languages.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593287/0fc2b37833f7f21fc82997a7b4a6c0fb8bf6c9d6.png[/img]

[h1] 1.0.2 Update [/h1]
[list]
     [*]Added checkpoints so you don't have to re-prepare hide and seek every time you restart the game.
     [*]Increased movement speed when the player is crouch and walking.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593287/0fc2b37833f7f21fc82997a7b4a6c0fb8bf6c9d6.png[/img]

[h1] 1.0.1 Update [/h1]
[list]
     [*]Slightly reduced movement speed when Allen is walking.
     [*]Movement speed when the player is walking has been increased.
     [*]Slightly reduced the range of player walking footstep loudness that Allen can detect.
     [*] Some of the text in the Hide and Seek Guide has been modified.
[/list]
